title: 전통무예진흥법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Revocation of Designation of Traditional Martial Arts Eligible for Fostering, etc.) Where the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism intends to revoke or withdraw the designation of traditional martial arts eligible for fostering under Article 7 of the Act, the Minister shall notify the relevant traditional martial arts institution or organization in writing of the grounds and legal basis for the intended revocation or withdrawal, and shall allow it a period of at least 10 days to submit its opinions.
